title: Failed transaction whose second operation's own code is success: payment SUCCESS inside txFAILED is rolled back
caps_note: No CAP applies: a classic operation that predates CAPs.
why: Transaction 34a69fbc… failed with txFAILED: its first operation (path_payment_strict_send) failed with UNDER_DESTMIN, and its second (a payment of 1 DENEB to the asset's issuer) carries the result code PAYMENT_SUCCESS. stellar-core rolled both back: the transaction has no operation meta, and only the fee and the sequence number bump took effect. A reader that takes an operation's success from its own result code alone records the payment as successful (or as a movement) although nothing happened.

variants.notes: Real pubnet ledger with 509 transactions at Protocol 29; this entry's pattern is transaction 78 in apply order (position 81 in the classic phase's transaction set). Written by stellar-core 30.0.0 at the same protocol era, so it is not marked regenerated.

values.note: The transaction failed; the second operation's own result code is success.
A failed transaction has no operation meta: the payment coded success changed nothing.
The rolled-back payment: 1 DENEB to its issuer, from operation source GBOTDY25….

notes: Input of finding F-0071. Expected: every operation of a failed transaction is unsuccessful, whatever its own result code; here the payment (operation 1) is coded success and moved nothing, which the two count 0 movements pin. The kit's expectation vocabulary has no per-operation successful field, so the replay comparison sees the transaction's successful = false and its result codes, not an indexer's operation rows.
